I decided to up my dose to 33mg that is 11 3mg tablets. I am from Ireland and my past drug use is Heroin, Oxycontin, Valium,
Xanax, and others I was addicted to Heroin and Oxycontin for 6 years.
back to the Experience. I swallowed 11 lexotan tabs 3 mg which give 33mg.
30mins after ingesting I feel a heavy stone in my head.
38mins later, Strong muscle relaxant feeling on my upper and lower limbs.
45mins presence of some sort of euphoria along with a very happy High feeling.
55mins feeling is still strong - might re-dose on another 33mgs.
60mins redosed with 33mgs feeling very very stoned right now
walking, talking and interacting with others is very difficult think I will go sleep.
This was my highest dose to do far
.
Be safe and please don't mix this med with any Opiate.
Michael.
